title: Software Engineer III
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) team**
is responsible for managing and supporting the organization's core IT infrastructure, including servers and virtual machines. The team focuses on infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting to ensure high availability, reliability, security, and performance.
  
  
The IaaS team also supports infrastructure automation, capacity planning, incident resolution, and infrastructure optimization. Its primary goal is to provide a stable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure platform that enables applications and business services to run smoothly.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer III to design, develop, test, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions within IAAS Team. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, excellent problem-solving abilities, and experience working in Agile development environments.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, contributing to technical design decisions, ensuring engineering best practices, and delivering reliable solutions that support business objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure software applications.
* Develop high-quality, reusable, and maintainable code following established engineering standards.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and solution development.
* Build and maintain RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed applications.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and security best practices.
* Identify and resolve complex technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and production defects.
* Implement automated unit, integration, and functional testing to ensure software quality.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevOps practices.
* Monitor application performance, reliability, and operational health.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Take ownership of assigned features and deliverables from development through production deployment.
* Required Technical Skills
* Strong programming experience in Java, Python, JavaScript, or other object-oriented programming languages.
* Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture.
* Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and design patterns.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with Git, Maven, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent development and deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, or similar tools.
* Understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and messaging technologies such as Kafka.
* Familiarity with application security, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Typically 5–8 years of relevant software development experience, depending on organizational leveling.
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade applications.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical deliverables.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience developing applications in the banking, payments, or financial services domain.
* Knowledge of high-volume transaction processing systems.
* Experience with cloud-native application development.
* Understanding of system scalability, resilience, observability, and performance optimization.
* Familiarity with event-driven architecture and distributed messaging.
* Experience mentoring junior developers and contributing to engineering excellence.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries

* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure Solutions
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior Software Engineer to join our AI Infrastructure Solutions team in Pune. This is your opportunity to work on groundbreaking technologies and help build the future of computing! NVIDIA is a global leader in innovation, offering a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Pune or equivalent experience. We value diversity and provide equal opportunities to all candidates. If you’re passionate about building scalable AI platforms and autonomous agent solutions that impact industries worldwide, we want to hear from you!
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and operate AI infrastructure solutions that power LLM-based applications and autonomous agents across the enterprise.
* Develop agentic AI workflows and multi-agent systems, including tool calling, planning, memory, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar.
* Integrate and serve LLMs through APIs and inference endpoints, optimizing for latency, throughput, cost, and reliability.
* Containerize applications with Docker and deploy and scale them on Kubernetes, including Helm charts, autoscaling, and GPU-enabled workloads.
* Take applications to L3 level: own production readiness, advanced troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, performance tuning, and escalation support for complex issues beyond L1/L2.
* Define and maintain observability for AI systems, including logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring of agent behavior, LLM quality, and system health.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment of AI applications and infrastructure.
* Develop high-performance backend services and RESTful APIs (Python and/or .NET Core) that expose AI capabilities to internal applications.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years working on AI/LLM-based solutions.
* Hands-on experience building agentic AI and autonomous agent systems, including tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and RAG pipelines.
* Strong experience with LLMs and their integration (OpenAI-compatible APIs, NVIDIA NIM, Hugging Face, or similar), prompt engineering, and evaluation.
* Strong proficiency in Python; experience with C#/.NET Core and ASP.NET Core for REST API development is a plus.
* Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including deploying, scaling, and troubleshooting containerized workloads in production.
* Proven experience supporting applications at L3 level, including incident management, debugging, performance optimization, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and Git-based workflows.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with GPU-accelerated workloads, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA NIM, Triton Inference Server, or NeMo.
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-to-agent communication patterns.
* Experience with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and safety frameworks.
* Contributions to open-source AI or infrastructure projects.

NVIDIA delivers competitive pay, a wide range of benefits, and the possibility to contribute to groundbreaking technologies. Join us in building the future of computing! Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organization, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery – shaping the lens of “only Amplify Health can do”.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**Why Amplify Health and this Opportunity**

Amplify Health is shaping the future of healthcare in the Asia. Joining Amplify Health means joining one of the region’s largest and strongest health-tech and AI companies.

Through our unique brain-bank, technology and strength of vision, as well as the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery, we are able to deliver value to our customer in the way “only Amplify Health can do”.

Amplify Health is a place for courageous entrepreneurs, who believe in working as a collaborative team to build industry-defining products and are committed to transforming healthcare through technology.

**The Position**

**Role Overview**

The Senior Backend Engineer is a hands-on customer implementation engineering role responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying and supporting backend solutions that connect Amplify Health products with customer platforms and operational workflows. The role is based in India and reports to the Implementation Lead.

The role combines strong Java and Spring engineering capability with practical ownership of client-facing APIs, FHIR gateways, mapping and validation services, claims-processing flows, database changes, environment readiness, controlled releases and production issue resolution. The successful candidate will work closely with Senior Backend Engineers, Product Engineering, QA, Platform/DevOps, Service Management and customer technology teams to deliver reliable end-to-end solutions within agreed implementation scope and timelines.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Customer Implementation Engineering**

* Own backend engineering deliverables for assigned customer implementations from technical analysis and estimation through development, testing, deployment and post-release validation.
* Translate approved customer requirements and functional designs into practical implementation solutions aligned with product capability and architecture.
* Build customer-facing integration components without compromising the maintainability and reuse of underlying product services.
* Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and provide clear options and recommendations to the Implementation Lead and relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate implementation work across Product Engineering, QA, Platform/DevOps, Business Analysis, clinical and customer technology teams.

**2) FHIR, API and Integration Delivery**

* Design, develop and maintain RESTful APIs, FHIR gateway services, mapping layers, callbacks and service-to-service integrations using Java and Spring Boot.
* Implement mappings between customer payloads, HL7 FHIR resources and internal claims models, with clear validation and error-handling behaviour.
* Work with business and technical stakeholders to clarify field definitions, source-system ownership, mandatory data, validation rules and response expectations.
* Implement validations at the appropriate service boundary and ensure actionable errors are propagated consistently through client-facing responses.
* Prepare and maintain API specifications, payload examples, mapping documents and technical notes needed for customer integration and testing.

**3) Claims and Pre-Authorisation Solution Delivery**

* Develop and support implementation logic for claims processing, benefit matching, calculations, tariffs, provider information, clinical mappings and pre-authorisation workflows.
* Build and support end-to-end request and response flows across customer channels, gateways, data-enrichment components and Core Claims services.
* Analyse customer-specific requirements and determine whether each need should be handled through product capability, configuration, integration logic or an approved workaround.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering and Business Analysts where product gaps, enhancements or reusable capabilities are identified.
* Ensure implementation behaviour is traceable to agreed requirements and test scenarios.

**4) Data, Database and Migration Activities**

* Design and maintain backend persistence and data-processing components using PostgreSQL, SQL, Hibernate and JPA.
* Write and review database scripts, schema changes, data corrections, cleanup jobs and migration utilities required for customer implementation and release activities.
* Assess data volume, dependencies, integrity and rollback considerations before executing changes in customer environments.
* Use controlled migration practices such as Flyway or equivalent tooling and clearly document any manual scripts or decisions required during execution.
* Optimise database queries and batch-processing logic to support implementation performance and operational requirements.

**5) Environment, Deployment and Release Readiness**

* Work with Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and approved CI/CD pipelines to deploy and validate implementation services across sandbox, development, UAT, pre-production and production environments.
* Coordinate with Platform/DevOps and customer teams on environment configuration, endpoints, connectivity, secrets, access and deployment dependencies.
* Prepare implementation plans, build and version details, verification steps, fallback or rollback plans and release evidence for change approval.
* Support controlled releases and ensure that only approved implementation scope is promoted to each customer environment.
* Perform post-deployment technical validation and coordinate handover to QA, business testing and service-management teams.

**6) Testing, Quality and Security**

* Create unit and integration tests using JUnit, Mockito and related technologies, and provide testable builds and technical evidence to QA.
* Support SIT, UAT and regression testing by investigating defects across API, mapping, service, database and environment layers.
* Participate in code reviews and follow engineering standards for secure, maintainable, observable and supportable implementation code.
* Remediate application and dependency vulnerabilities and support evidence required for security review and release approval.
* Use feature flags or controlled configuration where appropriate to manage incomplete, phased or customer-specific functionality safely.

**7) Production Support, Performance and Reliability**

* Troubleshoot customer implementation and production issues using application logs, monitoring information, database evidence and code-level debugging.
* Perform structured root-cause analysis for failed requests, incorrect mappings, API errors, response failures, connectivity issues and performance degradation.
* Investigate end-to-end response time across gateways, claims services, external services, storage and asynchronous processing, and implement corrective actions.
* Design practical resilience measures covering timeouts, retries, asynchronous processing, idempotency, reconciliation and failure recovery.
* Support incidents, hotfixes, controlled production deployments and post-release monitoring while following agreed change processes.

**8) Delivery Ownership and Technical Leadership**

* Break complex implementation work into clear, actionable tasks, identify owners and dependencies, and support realistic delivery planning.
* Provide technical guidance to implementation developers, review pull requests and help resolve complex integration, deployment and data issues.
* Maintain accurate implementation records in Jira, Confluence, API specifications, release notes and operational runbooks.
* Communicate technical status, blockers, risks and options clearly to the Implementation Lead and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Support knowledge transfer, reusable implementation patterns and continuous improvement across customer delivery teams.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on backend or integration development in enterprise applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security and Spring Integration.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering microservices, RESTful APIs, JSON integrations and server-side business logic.
* Practical experience with API mapping, validation, error handling and gateway or integration-layer development.
* Strong PostgreSQL and SQL skills, including relational modelling, query optimisation, transactions, scripts and controlled database migration.
* Hands-on experience with Hibernate/JPA, JUnit, Mockito, Maven or Gradle, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
* Experience supporting deployments across multiple environments and preparing implementation, verification and rollback plans.
* Experience troubleshooting production issues using logs, monitoring and database evidence, with strong root-cause analysis capability.
* Experience with application security, authentication and authorisation, secrets management, dependency remediation and secure coding practices.
* Experience in health insurance, claims processing, benefit configuration, pre-authorisation or healthcare technology is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on familiarity with HL7 FHIR, particularly Claim, ClaimResponse or related healthcare integration patterns, is strongly preferred.
* Experience with asynchronous messaging, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Redis, workflow engines or rules engines is advantageous.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical requirements, risks and decisions to customer and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage delivery priorities and collaborate effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
* Ability to work effectively from India with a reporting line to the Implementation Lead; occasional regional travel or after-hours release support may be required.

**What You Will Gain in This Role**

* End-to-end ownership of customer implementation engineering across APIs, FHIR, claims processing, data and cloud deployment.

* Opportunity to shape reusable implementation patterns, technical delivery standards and the reliability of customer-facing solutions.

**Join Us**

If you are a passionate individual who thrives in a collaborative environment of bar raisers, and where courage, innovation and resilience are celebrated; we invite you to join our team. Together, we will shape the future with our unwavering commitment to excellence and the determination to make a difference.

We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**Agentic AI Feature & Workflow Development**

* Build and integrate AI-driven features using LLM APIs (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini on Vertex AI)
* Design and implement tool-using agents (structured function calling, schema validation, retries, fallbacks)
* Build multi-agent workflows when appropriate (e.g., planner/worker, reviewer/critic, specialist routing) and know when a simpler architecture is better
* Create agentic workflows such as document understanding, extraction, reasoning over evidence, task automation, and multi-step decision support
* Own context engineering end-to-end:
* dynamic context assembly (retrieval + state + tool outputs)
* context budgeting and compression/summarization
* grounding strategies to reduce hallucinations and improve consistency
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and search workflows using off-the-shelf vector stores and embedding services

**Evaluation, Quality & Iteration (Core)**

* Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, reliability, and output quality
* Build task-specific eval suites: golden datasets, adversarial cases, regression tests, and rubric-based scoring
* Set up automated evaluation pipelines and release gates (CI/CD-friendly) tied to prompt/model/version changes
* Define and monitor online metrics (e.g., task success rate, human override rate, safety flags, latency, cost) and run experiments/A-B tests where appropriate
* Use LLM-as-judge responsibly: calibrate, validate, and pair with human labels when needed

**Engineering, Integration & Observability**

* Develop scalable backend services and APIs that incorporate AI functionality
* Integrate AI pipelines into existing cloud, microservices, and event-driven architectures
* Implement observability and analytics for all AI features (tracing, evaluations, prompt versioning, cost tracking) Example tooling: Langfuse (and/or OpenTelemetry-compatible stacks)
* Ensure reliability, uptime, performance, and security of AI services
* Build internal tooling for evaluation, testing, prompt/version management, and safe deployment

**Product & Collaboration**

* Partner with product managers, designers, the Chief Architect, and domain SMEs to shape AI-first solutions
* Rapidly prototype concepts and iterate based on user feedback and measurable eval results
* Translate business problems into well-structured AI workflows without requiring ML model training
* Document system behavior, known failure modes, and operational playbooks

**Governance & Safety**

* Implement guardrails, checks, and fallback logic for safe and predictable AI behavior
* Help define and follow compliance, privacy, and responsible AI guidelines
* Design for safe tool execution (bounded actions, permissions, escalation paths, human-in the-loop review

**Core Strengths (Required)**

* Strong software engineering background (Python preferred) and experience shipping backend services
* Deep hands-on experience building agentic LLM systems from first principles: agent loops, tool interfaces, planning/replanning, memory/state, and failure handling
* Strong context engineering ability: retrieval strategies, routing, grounding, context budgeting, and long-context tradeoffs
* Strong evaluation discipline: golden datasets, regression gating, automated eval pipelines, and online monitoring
* Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) and AI orchestration frameworks
* Excellent debugging, systems thinking, and problem decomposition skills
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership

**Signals We Value**

* You’ve shipped an LLM/agent system in production and can clearly explain:
* the failure modes you discovered
* the evals you built to catch regressions
* how you improved cost/latency while increasing quality
* how you monitored and iterated safely over time
* You keep up with industry developments (model releases, frameworks, best practices) and can translate them into pragmatic improvement

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or GCP), microservices, and event-driven systems
* Experience with observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Honeycomb) and AI-specific tooling (e.g., Langfuse, Braintrust, HumanLoop, MLFlow)
* Experience with workflow orchestration for long-running jobs (Temporal, Celery, Airflow)
* Experience building enterprise AI features (permissions, auditability, compliance constraints)
* Experience with safety/policy layers (PII handling, prompt injection defenses, sandboxed tool execution)

**Why Join Us**

* Build core AI capabilities that directly impact users and product strategy
* Work on cutting-edge, real-world agentic systems—focused on applied engineering (no model training required)
* High ownership, fast iteration cycles, and strong cross-functional collaboration
* Competitive compensation and opportunities for rapid advancement

**What Your First 90 Days Could Look Like**
Ship one production agent workflow end-to-end with:
  
  

* tracing + observability
* an offline eval suite with regression gates
* cost/latency targets and monitoring
* documented failure modes and fallback path

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

Senior AI/ML Developer

Location: Coimbatore

The Mission: Building the Intelligence Layer for Financial Operations Anaiyan is building intelligent systems that transform complex, fragmented financial and operational data into reliable, structured and actionable information. We are working at the intersection of AI/ML, financial data, accounting, automation and agentic systems—solving problems where traditional rules-based software struggles with ambiguity, variability and context. Our systems need to understand real-world data from sources such as POS systems, bank statements, CRM/ERP exports, spreadsheets, invoices and accounting systems; identify relationships between records; infer transformations; reconcile financial events; and progressively learn from human decisions. We are looking for an engineer who wants to solve difficult problems in machine learning, LLMs, document/data understanding, reasoning, evaluation and production AI systems. If you enjoy taking an ambiguous problem, determining where AI actually adds value, building the system, measuring its behaviour and making it reliable enough for production, this is the environment you’ve been looking for.

Core Responsibilities

AI/ML System Development Design and develop production-grade AI/ML systems for financial and operational workflows. Work across: • LLM-based systems • Machine learning and deep learning • Classification and prediction • Semantic search & Anomaly detection • Recommendation and ranking • Structured reasoning Build hybrid systems combining deterministic rules, statistical models, embeddings and LLMs where appropriate. Agentic AI Systems Design and implement controlled AI agents for complex financial workflows. Build reliable agent architectures with: • Tool calling • State management • Planning • Context management • Verification • Confidence assessment • Human-in-the-loop controls • Retry and recovery mechanisms • Auditability LLM Engineering Work with leading foundation models and develop production applications using: • Structured generation • Function/tool calling • RAG • Embeddings • Prompt/context engineering • Model evaluation & routing • Fine-tuning • Cost and latency optimization Evaluate when a problem should be solved using an LLM versus conventional ML, deterministic logic or a hybrid approach. AI Evaluation & Reliability Build rigorous evaluation frameworks for AI systems. Define and measure: • Precision/recall • Classification accuracy • False-positive/false-negative rates • Confidence calibration • LLM response quality • Agent task completion • Regression performance Build representative synthetic and real-world evaluation datasets and automated regression suites.

Technical & Professional Qualifications

AI/ML Engineering Experience — 4+ years in ML engineering & AI engineering, with significant hands-on experience building and deploying production AI/ML systems. LLM & Generative AI Expertise — strong hands-on experience with modern LLM application development, including several of: OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, Pydantic AI, agent frameworks, structured outputs, tool/function calling, RAG, embeddings and LLM evaluation. Machine Learning Depth — strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, ranking, clustering, similarity/matching, NLP, information extraction, deep learning, model evaluation and statistical reasoning. Hands-on experience with PyTorch, scikit-learn or equivalent ML frameworks. Data & Backend Engineering — strong Python development skills and practical experience with SQL, PostgreSQL or equivalent databases, REST APIs, data pipelines, model/version management, Pandas/NumPy, JSON/CSV/Excel processing, Docker, Git and automated testing. Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures is valuable. AI/ML Production Engineering — experience deploying and operating AI/ML systems in production, with knowledge of model serving, MLOps/LLMOps, model/version management, observability, inference optimization, GPU/compute optimization, CI/CD, containerization and cloud infrastructure. Analytical Thinking — strong ability to break ambiguous problems into measurable components and determine the appropriate combination of rules, ML, LLMs, agents and human review, rather than defaulting to a single technology.

Who Should Apply This role is particularly suited for engineers who:

• Build systems and enjoy working with messy real-world data. • Are comfortable combining conventional engineering with AI. • Care deeply about evaluation and correctness. • Can reason about AI failure modes. • Are excited by agentic systems but understand their limitations. • Want to work on difficult financial-data problems. • Prefer solving open-ended problems over implementing predetermined specifications.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company’s Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.

At InMobi Advertising, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a Tech Lead / SDE IV to anchor and grow our Data Engineering capability within our Demand-Side Platform (DSP). This is a high-impact, technically hands-on leadership role at the intersection of real-time data infrastructure, programmatic advertising, and scalable backend systems. You will own the design and delivery of pipelines that power bidding intelligence, audience targeting, campaign analytics, and attribution — processing billions of bid-stream events daily. Alongside your data engineering mandate, you will architect and contribute to backend microservices that sit at the core of our DSP stack, including integrations with SSPs, ad exchanges, and identity resolution platforms. You will mentor a team of engineers, drive technical direction, and collaborate closely with product, ML, and growth functions to turn data into a true competitive advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Data Stack:

▸ Design and own end-to-end data pipelines — batch and real-time — handling bid requests, win/loss events, impression logs, click streams, and conversion signals at scale.

▸ Build and maintain our data lakehouse architecture (ingestion → storage → serving layer) optimized for low-latency DSP analytics and ML feature generation.

▸ Define standards for data quality, lineage, observability, and SLA adherence across all data products.

▸ Own and evolve our StarRocks deployment for real-time analytical queries — schema design, ingestion patterns, and query optimisation for DSP reporting workloads.

▸ Drive FinOps discipline across the data platform — track compute and storage costs, enforce resource quotas, identify optimisation opportunities, and report on unit economics.

▸ Establish and lead Data Governance practices: metadata management, data cataloguing, access control policies, PII classification, and data retention standards compliant with GDPR and CCPA.

Backend Microservices:

▸ Contribute to and review the design of backend services that power DSP functionality — bid shading, pacing, budget management, and reporting APIs.

▸ Architect data contracts and event schemas between microservices, ensuring consistency across the bid request lifecycle.

▸ Champion best practices in API design, service reliability (SLOs, circuit breakers, retries), and observability (distributed tracing, structured logging, metrics).

▸ Collaborate with the bidder team on low-latency data reads (Aerospike, Cassandra, or similar) for real-time targeting signal lookups.

Technical Leadership

▸ Lead architecture reviews, set engineering standards, and drive adoption of best practices across the data and backend engineering teams.

▸ Mentor SDE II/III engineers through code reviews, design sessions, and pair programming; grow the next generation of technical leaders.

▸ Partner with ML engineers on the full model lifecycle — feature engineering pipelines, offline training data generation, experiment tracking, and model serving infrastructure.

▸ Translate complex business requirements (campaign KPIs, ROAS, viewability, brand safety) into robust technical designs.

▸ Own the technical roadmap for data infrastructure — capacity planning, migration strategies, and build vs. buy decisions.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education**

▸ 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on data engineering or large-scale data systems.

▸ Prior experience in ad-tech, programmatic advertising, or real-time bidding (RTB) environments strongly preferred.

▸ Experience in ML engineering — feature engineering, building offline training pipelines, or collaborating closely on model productionisation — is preferred.

▸ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Data Engineering (Core)**

▸ Deep expertise in distributed stream processing frameworks — Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, or Apache Spark Structured Streaming.

▸ Strong command of SQL and experience optimizing complex analytical queries at petabyte scale.

▸ Hands-on experience with real-time analytical databases, particularly StarRocks; familiarity with Snowflake or ClickHouse is a plus.

▸ Proficiency with workflow orchestration tools: Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

▸ Solid understanding of data modelling — dimensional modelling, OBT patterns, and eventdriven schemas relevant to ad impression and attribution data.

▸ Familiarity with open table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.

**Backend & Systems**

▸ Proficiency in Python (primary) and/or Java/Scala for building production-grade services and data processing jobs.

▸ Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and/or gRPC-based microservices.

▸ Working knowledge of low-latency data stores (Aerospike, Cassandra) used for real-time lookups in the bidding path.

▸ Comfortable with containerised deployments on Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar).

title: ETL QA Data Engineer
description:
**About the Company -**

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience

transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and

India. We bring together a global team of engineers, architects, designers, researchers and

operators united by rigor, accountability and a commitment to delivering measurable

results.

For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the

Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful

business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence

and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision.

Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams

approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across

geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and

collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment

where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the

intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong

global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

**Role Overview-**

We are seeking an ETL QA Data Engineer to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and

reliability of data pipelines and analytics outputs across high-volume, event-driven

domains such as emergency response, public safety, and healthcare operations. The role

involves validating data ingestion and transformation logic, reconciling records between

source and target systems, detecting anomalies, and ensuring reporting and dashboards

reflect trustworthy data.

**Key Responsibilities-**

1. Data Validation & Reconciliation

• Perform source-to-target reconciliation for event- and transaction-style datasets

across ingestion and curated layers.

• Validate completeness, timeliness, and consistency of daily and near-real-time

ingestion pipelines.

• Identify and investigate data anomalies, including missing records, spikes or drops,

duplicates, out-of-range values, and schema drift.

• Validate the correctness of KPIs and metrics used in dashboards and reports,

including volumes, rates, turnaround times, and error trends.

• Ensure referential integrity across key entities such as events/encounters,

units/resources, locations, and agencies/sites.

• Partner with engineering teams to debug discrepancies, identify root causes, and

validate fixes.

2. Automation & Framework Development

• Build and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python and testing

frameworks such as PyTest or Unittest.

• Develop reusable validation assets, including reconciliation templates, data quality

rules, and regression suites for critical pipelines.

• Create data quality rules covering nulls, ranges, uniqueness, and referential

integrity.

• Integrate validation into CI/CD and orchestration workflows, including validation

gates for pipeline runs.

• Produce validation artifacts such as test reports, defect summaries, and data

quality scorecards for ongoing monitoring.

3. AI-Assisted Validation

• Use AI tools and LLM-based solutions, such as Qodo, to accelerate validation query

generation, reconciliation logic, and test case creation.

• Leverage AI-assisted techniques to identify edge cases, explore anomaly detection

ideas, and expand test coverage.

• Validate all AI-generated outputs against actual data and documented business

rules before adoption.

4. Data Quality & Reporting Reliability

• Ensure reporting layers and dashboards accurately reflect validated source data

and business definitions.

• Identify and report data quality issues that may affect downstream analytics and

operational decision-making.

• Support the development of repeatable and documented validation rules aligned

with business metrics.

• Contribute to early detection of anomalies and reduction of downstream reporting

issues.

5. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

• Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and other relevant teams to

investigate pipeline failures and data discrepancies.

• Support incident triage and fix verification to improve resolution efficiency.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of data testing practices, validation

frameworks, and quality monitoring.

Required Technical Skills & Competencies

• Strong SQL skills for data reconciliation and validation, including joins,

aggregations, window functions, and data profiling.

• Hands-on Python experience for test automation and data validation.

• Experience in ETL/ELT QA, data testing, analytics validation, or data quality

engineering.

• Understanding of event-driven and transaction-based systems and common

pipeline failure patterns, including late-arriving data, corrections, and duplicates.

• Experience validating large datasets and reporting layers in environments with high

reliability expectations.

**Must-Have Skills-**

• SQL

• Python

• ETL/ELT QA

• Data Validation & Reconciliation

• Data Quality Testing

• Test Automation

• Source-to-Target Validation

• Data Anomaly Investigation

**Good to Have Skills-**

• Great Expectations or custom Python validation frameworks.

• dbt tests or similar data validation frameworks.

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

• Exposure to Databricks or Spark.

• Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory (ADF), or

Prefect.

• Experience with sensitive data handling and privacy/security considerations.

• Exposure to interoperability and integration patterns such as APIs, HL7/FHIR, EDI,

and batch feeds, as applicable to the environment.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools and LLM-based validation support.

**Desired Attributes-**

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data accuracy and detail.

• Ability to investigate complex data discrepancies and identify root causes.

• A quality-focused mindset with an emphasis on data reliability and reporting integrity.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and analytics teams.

• Commitment to documenting validation rules and maintaining reusable testing assets.

• Sound judgment when using AI-assisted tools, with a focus on human verification.

**What Success Looks Like-**

• Automated validation coverage for critical pipelines, including freshness, completeness, and reconciliation.

• Early detection of anomalies and measurable reduction in downstream reporting issues.

• Repeatable, documented validation rules aligned with business definitions and metrics.

• Efficient collaboration with engineering teams to shorten incident triage and fix verification cycles.

title: Staff Quality Engineer - India
description:

About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

About the role:
  

As a Staff / Principal Quality Engineer (Pillar Lead) on our Engineering team in India, you will serve as the primary quality coordinator and strategic anchor for one of our core product pillars. You will not just test software; you will act as an "Internal Product Manager for Quality." You will work closely with Engineering Directors and Product Managers to align quality initiatives with Pillar OKRs, ensure developers share accountability for automation, and guide the overarching test strategy for your domain. This role is designed for a highly experienced technical authority and proactive risk mitigator who thrives on driving cross-module alignment, adopting cutting-edge AI testing solutions, and ensuring every release meets the highest standards of enterprise excellence.

**What you’ll be doing:**
  

  
* Serve as the local expert and ultimate technical authority for your Pillar's test processes, feature interactions, and quality standards.
  
* Engage early in the SDLC, contributing significantly to refinement, planning meetings, and RFC/Design reviews.
  **Challenge Product Managers**
  and Engineering Leads to consider testability, competitive edge, and integration risks before a single line of code is written.
  
* **Review and influence Pillar OKRs**
  (e.g., engineering velocity, reliability) to identify partnership opportunities where QE tactics directly drive business objectives.
  
* **Take accountability for the quality**
  of your Pillar by proactively identifying weak spots, automation blockers, and resource gaps, and aggressively escalating these to leadership to request support.
  
* Represent your Pillar in the Cross-Module Leadership Team to coordinate
  **cross-team impacts,**
  share industry-leading practices, and align on standardized test plans and tooling across all pillars.
  
* Architect and
  **lead non-functional testing strategies**
  across the pillar, explicitly championing performance, load, and scale testing to ensure the platform reliably handles enterprise-level concurrency and data volumes.
  
* **Drive AI Adoption & Standardization**
  : Champion the use of AI in the testing lifecycle. Collaborate with the Internal Tools (Autobots) team to contribute to, adopt, and standardize common AI-based testing solutions across your pillar (e.g., leveraging AI for test script generation, intelligent failure triage, and pipeline optimization).
  
* Champion the philosophy that
  **quality is a shared engineering goal**
  , ensuring development teams are equally accountable for automation maintenance and preventing the anti-pattern of "throwing it over the wall to QA."
  
* Intelligently allocate QE efforts within your Pillar, prioritizing high-value user journeys and guiding your team to swarm on the most critical initiatives.
  
* Contribute test code, audit Developer Unit/Integration tests for coverage gaps, and actively write complex End-to-End (E2E) automation scripts alongside your team.
  
* Establish and enforce best practices for unit and functional testing frameworks to ensure comprehensive component and flow validation.
  
* Develop and execute strategies to consistently augment unit, functional, and acceptance test coverage across the pillar, tying coverage goals directly to release quality gates.
  
* Partner closely with your Pillar’s dedicated Automation Enablement engineer to ensure framework gaps are closed and flaky tests are managed urgently.
  
* Act as a strong mentor and teacher of nuanced testing principles to both Feature QEs and Developers, empowering others to do the work while continuing to deliver impact yourself.
  
  

  
**We’re looking for:**
  

  
* 8–12+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test, or a related field, with a proven track record of leading quality initiatives across multiple teams.
  
* Deep expertise in multiple technical disciplines, programming languages (Python, Pytest, Playwright and Typescript preferred), test tools, and automation frameworks.
  
* Proven experience defining and executing performance, scale, and load testing strategies for complex distributed systems.
  
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate "build vs. buy" decisions and develop entirely new implementations of industry solutions.
  
* Strong strategic problem-solving perspective, with the ability to balance release risk vs. schedule to maximize test execution without sacrificing the speed of delivery.
  
* High EQ and emotional maturity; an active listener who accepts feedback willingly, seeks opposing points of view, and prioritizes the best solution over being right.
  
* Proactive and humble ownership, with a focus on raising the visibility of your team's work, sharing credit, and asking for help when facing insurmountable risks.
  
* Excellent communication and influence skills, capable of representing the engineering organization internally and externally.
  
* A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with the ability to unblock teams and coordinate actions across the organization.
  
  

  
**Bonus Points:**
  

  
* Practical experience leveraging Generative AI or LLMs in the software testing lifecycle, or actively contributing to AI-driven test frameworks and internal AI tooling.
  
* Deep domain expertise in areas relevant to the Pillar.
  
* Experience driving large-scale organizational transformations or shifts in quality methodologies.
  
* Prior experience in dynamic, fast-paced startup environments.
  
* Experience with API and web app UI test automation tools like Gherkin, Cypress, or similar.
  
* Experience deploying, installing, and configuring applications on cloud-based servers (AWS experience is a plus).

title: Lead, AI Data Engineer
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Role Overview**

As Lead, AI Data Engineering, you will lead multiple teams and projects that deliver data and AI solutions on Azure and Databricks, and act as a trusted technical advisor to clients and senior stakeholders. You stay hands-on, shaping architectures, building reference implementations and reviewing critical code, while setting the technical direction, delivery standards and talent strategy for AI data engineering. Your job is to turn AI ambition into governed, measurable outcomes: help clients choose the right use cases, design the data foundations to support them, and make sure they run reliably and responsibly at scale.

**Role at a Glance**

* **Experience:**
  12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including 4+ years leading multiple teams and 3+ years delivering AI/ML or GenAI solutions
* **Team leadership:**
  Leads multiple teams or pods (typically 8 to 20 engineers, including lead engineers); line-manages leads and senior engineers
* **Project scope:**
  Accountable for multiple concurrent projects or programmes (typically 3 or more)
* **Stakeholder / client exposure:**
  Client-facing trusted advisor; leads technical solutioning, pre-sales and executive engagement
* **Hands-on expectation:**
  About 30 to 50% hands-on (architecture, reference implementations, critical code and reviews, proofs of concept)

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy and architecture**

* Define the AI data engineering vision, reference architectures and reusable accelerators (for example, RAG ingestion frameworks, evaluation harnesses, MCP / agent data-access patterns and governance templates) used across projects.
* Act as design authority across projects: review and approve solution architectures, key trade-offs and non-functional requirements (security, scalability, cost, resilience, disaster recovery).
* Maintain a technology radar for data and AI (lakehouse, agentic AI, evaluation, AI gateways, open table formats) and lead structured evaluations of new platforms and vendors.
* Stay hands-on: build reference implementations and proofs of concept, lead reviews of critical production incidents, and review high-risk code and designs.

**Client and business engagement**

* Serve as the senior technical counterpart for clients and business executives: shape AI and data roadmaps and prioritise use cases by value, feasibility and risk.
* Lead technical solutioning for pre-sales, proposals and statements of work: scope, architecture, estimates, assumptions, client dependencies and risks.
* Present to executive and board-level audiences, translating technical choices into business impact, risk and cost.
* Build long-term client relationships and identify opportunities to expand and improve engagements.

**Delivery leadership**

* Oversee delivery of multiple concurrent projects, ensuring quality, timelines, budget and margin, and resolving escalations.
* Establish delivery governance: architecture reviews, AI release gates (evaluation thresholds, red-teaming, guardrails), production-readiness reviews and post-incident reviews.
* Drive FinOps for data and AI: forecast, optimise and report platform, GPU and token costs.

**Governance, risk and responsible AI**

* Own responsible-AI and AI-risk practices across the portfolio, aligned with frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, Singapore's Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI and the EU AI Act where applicable.
* Work with legal, compliance, data protection and security teams on AI risk assessments, data residency, consent, auditability and the limits of agent autonomy.
* Ensure sensitive data, including health and personal data, is protected by design across every solution.

**People and capability leadership**

* Lead, manage and develop multiple teams, including lead engineers: set goals, run performance reviews and plan succession.
* Own the skills framework and learning roadmap for AI data engineering: identify skill gaps, sponsor certifications and run communities of practice.
* Lead hiring strategy and team design (pod structure, skill mix, location mix).
* Set the standard and policy for AI-assisted and agentic engineering across teams, balancing productivity with quality, security and IP protection.
* Build a culture of engineering excellence, psychological safety, learning and innovation.

**Candidate Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering or data architecture, with 4+ years leading multiple teams or a practice of 8+ engineers, including leads.
* Expert, current hands-on skills in Python, PySpark and SQL, Azure and Databricks lakehouse engineering, and distributed system design.
* A track record of delivering multiple GenAI / ML solutions to production at enterprise scale, including RAG or agentic systems, evaluation frameworks and LLMOps.
* Deep data and AI architecture expertise: lakehouse, streaming, unstructured data, vector retrieval, semantic layers, model serving, AI gateways and MCP-based agent integration.
* Strong grounding in data governance, privacy, security and responsible AI in regulated environments.
* Proven client-facing experience: pre-sales solutioning, estimation, statement-of-work inputs, executive presentations and managing client expectations.
* Experience managing multi-project delivery, budgets and risks.
* Proven people leadership: hiring, performance management, coaching leads and building learning programmes.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills with technical, business and executive audiences.

**Technology stack: Primary stack (Azure + Databricks)**

* **Cloud & storage:**
  ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake
* **Lakehouse & processing:**
  Azure Databricks: Delta Lake, Lakeflow (Connect, Spark Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Structured Streaming, Photon, serverless compute
* **Governance & catalog:**
  Unity Catalog (lineage, tags, ABAC, row/column security), Microsoft Purview
* **AI, retrieval & agents:**
  Databricks Vector Search, Model Serving, Agent Bricks, Lakebase; Azure AI Search; Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI and other models, Agent Service); Azure AI Document Intelligence
* **MLOps / LLMOps:**
  MLflow 3 (tracking, tracing, evaluation, prompt registry), Feature Store, Unity AI Gateway, inference tables
* **Engineering & DevOps:**
  Python, PySpark, SQL, Git, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, Terraform / Bicep, Databricks Asset Bundles, Docker
* **AI-assisted engineering:**
  GitHub Copilot, Databricks Genie Code / Assistant

**Nice to have**

* Industry depth in healthcare, insurance or financial services; familiarity with data standards such as HL7 FHIR and regional privacy regulations (for example, PDPA, PDPO, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Experience setting up AI governance (AI system inventory, risk tiering, model and agent registers) or an AI centre of excellence.
* Multi-cloud (AWS, GCP) experience and Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric interoperability.
* Thought leadership: talks, publications, open-source contributions or partner advisory boards.
* Consulting, product management or business qualifications (for example, an MBA).

**Preferred certifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate.
* IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP) or ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer (desirable).
* TOGAF or an equivalent architecture certification (optional).

**How you lead**

* Trusted advisor: clients and executives seek your view because you are candid about value, risk and trade-offs.
* Multiplier: you raise the capability of every team through standards, reusable assets and coaching of leads.
* Hands-on credibility: you can still go deep on architecture and code when it matters.
* Accountability: you own outcomes across the portfolio, including responsible and secure use of AI.

**How success is measured**

* Portfolio delivery: projects delivered on scope, quality, timeline and budget, with no unmanaged critical risks.
* Client outcomes: client satisfaction, renewals and expansions, and AI use cases moved from pilot to production with measured business value.
* Reusable assets: accelerators and reference architectures adopted across projects, reducing delivery time and cost.
* Responsible AI: all AI solutions pass release gates and governance reviews, with no material data or AI incidents.
* People: engaged teams, leads developed and promoted, and strong growth in skills and certifications.
* Thought leadership: active communities of practice and external talks or publications.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
**Eurofins Scientific**
is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

title: Senior PMO Tooling Analyst
description:
**APEX FUND SERVICES**

**Functional Title: Senior PMO Tooling & Automation Analyst**

**Department: PMO (Portfolio Management Office)**

**Employment Type: Permanent**

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With fifty offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients, and family offices. The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. You are prepared to work hard, love what they do and be prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more that we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.

**About the Role**

The Senior PMO Tooling & Automation Analyst will partner with PMO leadership, Portfolio Leads, Project Managers, Technology teams and business stakeholders to design, build and optimise tooling and automation that strengthens PMO control, improves portfolio visibility and reduces manual effort. The role will combine practical PMO experience with deep technical capability across Azure DevOps (ADO), Power BI, ServiceNow and the Microsoft Power Platform.

The role will own the design and continuous improvement of integrated PMO tooling solutions, including workflow automation, data integration, executive dashboards, governance controls and self-service reporting. The role holder will translate PMO requirements into scalable tools, establish technical standards and deliver reliable management information for portfolio decision-making.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on tooling and automation expert who can independently configure platforms, develop data models and dashboards, automate workflows, troubleshoot solutions and guide users. They will bring relevant experience delivering PMO technology solutions in a complex enterprise environment and will balance rapid improvement with appropriate data governance, security and change control.

**Key duties and responsibilities**

This role will sit within the central Enterprise PMO and support the wider PMO community. The role holder will lead the design, build, administration and adoption of PMO tools and automated solutions across Azure DevOps, Power BI, ServiceNow, Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and related Microsoft technologies. Responsibilities include solution design, integration, reporting, data governance, documentation, training and continuous improvement.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**The Role**

The Site Reliability Engineer keeps a real-time customer decisioning platform for a leading UK telecoms group reliable in production. The platform decides which offer, message or next step each customer sees, across three consumer brands and every channel, so an outage or a slow response reaches customers at once.

You'll set and track service objectives, build the monitoring and alerting the team relies on, lead incident response and make releases safe. The role is based in India. You'll be part of an on-call rota and support production releases, which run late in the evening UK time and so at night in India. You'll make operations AI-operated by design: agents that triage alerts, read logs and traces, and draft incident timelines and runbooks, while a person approves anything that changes production.

This is a client-facing consulting role requiring confident engagement with client stakeholders, calm judgement under pressure, and the credibility to stop a release that isn't safe.

What the role owns. Production reliability: service level objectives and error budgets, monitoring and alerting, incident response and post-incident reviews, the on-call rota, release support and rollback readiness, and capacity and resilience. The DevOps Engineer owns the delivery platform, and you work as one team with them. The Lead Technical Consultant owns architecture and technical risk, and you contribute through ADRs. The Agentic Delivery Manager coordinates releases and tracks incidents and defects with you. Product engineers own their services in production, and you make that safe.

What we expect of everyone. Every role on this team, consultant or engineer, works with a product engineering mindset and an AI engineering mindset. You own the outcome, not the ticket: you understand the business problem, shape the requirement, make and record the decision, ship in small steps and check the result in production. AI is part of how you work, not a side project: you use AI assistants and agents every day, build with them where they help, check what they produce and share what works.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Take your turn on the on-call rota, respond to production alerts and incidents out of hours, and escalate early with options.
* Support late-night production releases: readiness checks, live monitoring during and after deployment, release verification and fast rollback.
* Lead incident response: triage, mitigation, communication and restoring service, then run blameless post-incident reviews and see the actions through.
* Define service level indicators and objectives with product engineers and the client, and track error budgets.
* Build logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerts that someone acts on, and remove noisy alerts.
* Write and maintain runbooks, and automate the steps that repeat.
* Build AI agents into operations with the AI Technical Consultant, such as alert triage, log and trace analysis, incident timelines and runbook drafting, with human approval for any change to production.
* Run production readiness reviews for new services and major changes.
* Test capacity, performance and resilience, including failure and recovery exercises.
* Work with the DevOps Engineer on safe deployment, such as feature flags, canary rollout and automated verification, and on the move from AWS to GCP with operational parity.
* Track recurring incidents and defects with the Agentic Delivery Manager and Product Support, and feed the lessons back to the engineers.
* Keep Kafka, PostgreSQL and the services around them healthy, with the engineers who own them.
* Write ADRs for significant reliability decisions and take part in the weekly ADR review.

**Strong candidates may come from roles such as:**

* 6-10 years of Production or application support engineers who have moved into site reliability engineering.
* DevOps or platform engineers who have carried an on-call rota for customer-facing services.
* Backend engineers who have owned their services in production, including out of hours.
* Operations or command-centre engineers who have automated their way into engineering.
* Consultancy engineers who have run managed services or round-the-clock support for clients.

**Useful Experience**

* OpenTelemetry, and incident tooling such as PagerDuty or Opsgenie.
* Chaos engineering, failure testing or disaster-recovery exercises.
* Kafka operations, PostgreSQL performance and JVM tuning.
* GitLab CI/CD and progressive delivery.
* Enterprise change and incident processes, including release trains.
* Moving workloads from AWS to GCP, with operational-parity validation.
* Certifications are welcome but not required: we weigh evidence over badges.

**What success looks like**

These outcomes describe what good looks like in the role. They are not additional CV screening requirements.

**First 90 days**

* You're on the on-call rota, with runbooks you trust for the services you cover.
* Every release in your window has readiness checks, live monitoring and a rollback plan.
* Alert noise is down, and every alert that pages someone has an owner and a runbook.
* An AI agent helps with triage or incident write-ups, with a named human check.

**First six months**

* Service objectives agreed and tracked for the most critical services, with error budgets in use.
* Time to restore service improves against your 90-day baseline.
* Repeat incidents fall, because post-incident actions close.
* Releases go out without surprises, and a rollback, when needed, works first time.
